name: TimeTree
description: TimeTree is a shared calendar for coordinating plans with families, friends, schools, clubs, and other groups. People create separate calendars, invite members, add and discuss events, and combine calendars through filters to see their schedules together.
agentUseSummary: TimeTree cannot be connected to Relay agents because TimeTree officially terminated its Connect App API on 22 December 2023, including applications created by developers, and no replacement public account API or remote MCP service is available.

blocked.label: Connect a TimeTree account
blocked.description: TimeTree terminated its Connect App API, including developer-created applications, and no supported replacement OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP connection contract is available.

blocked.label: Use TimeTree account data
blocked.description: The former public API no longer provides a supported way to read or change a customer's calendars, members, events, or comments.

blocked.label: Run TimeTree agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot call discontinued endpoints, reuse obsolete OAuth applications, or reverse engineer TimeTree's private application interface.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled because TimeTree terminated its developer API and has not published a supported replacement.

providerSetup.blocker: TimeTree officially terminated the Connect App API function on 22 December 2023 and stated that developer-created applications would no longer work; its former developer URLs now redirect to that termination notice.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider TimeTree only if the provider launches and documents a supported replacement account API, delegated OAuth contract, or remote MCP service.

evidence.supports: TimeTree describes a shared calendar for coordinating multiple group calendars, invitations, events, and combined schedule views.
TimeTree states that the Connect App API function terminated on 22 December 2023 and specifically lists applications created by developers among those that no longer work.
TimeTree's former developer portal now redirects to the official Connect App API termination notice rather than exposing live API documentation or application registration.
TimeTree continues to document user-facing external-calendar use inside its apps, which is distinct from a supported third-party account API.
